evd_title: GPT-3.5 achieved Pearson r=0.651 in predicting review aspect scores when given the human-written review
finding: GPT-3.5 achieved Pearson r=0.651 in predicting review aspect scores when given the human-written review
P: 427 official ICLR-2017 reviews with 1.3k human aspect scores (PeerRead), CS/ML
I: GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 (16k for whole paper), temp 0.3; few-shot (5 examples) given the human review; also zero-shot, MCQ, paper-only
C: Most-frequent-score baseline; gold human aspect scores; paper-only input conditions
O: Pearson r: given review few-shot 0.651 (Spearman 0.659) vs baseline 0.333; given paper only 0.131-0.258
